notes.title: The new patch is out! 2.20! New Server!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 

[h1]The new patch is out! [/h1]

[list]
[*]New reward chests - simplified the chests at main categories of possible drops (equipment, drone, active skills, gems, and materials) with each one possible different rarities which change the main stats (in case of equipment, drone, active, skills and gems) or quantity (in the case of material boxes)

[*]New database - weren't able to move the accounts from the old one but with the new database the data are more secured and faster on being changed from both sides (the player and the developer)

[*]New exp system - the formula of the exps needed for the next level has been changed in order to make the leveling easier at first levels and slower at higher

[*]New items stats formula - the main stats of each equipped item (weapons, bodies etc) have been changed which may lead to a different result of the existed items in the offline mode. Extra stats and slots for gems have been upgraded also

[*]Statistics are account general - The statistics of kills for each weapon or amount of using of specific actions are shared to all online slots of yours and they have been removed from the offline one (cause most of them are connected with achievements which are only unlocked to online mode) 

[*]Easy mode became easier - the stats of enemies at easy mode have been reduced to make the experience and the exploration easier

[/list]


Cause of the new database old accounts wasn't able to be moved there as mentioned above and cause of the changes on the non-equipment items at offline mode any bought decoration items need to re-bought

Hope people that had problems with the previous versions found a solution in this big update and in case of any bugs or problems or suggestions let us know either here or join our discord at
[url=https://discordapp.com/invite/95zaj87]DISCORD[/URL]

notes.title: Preview Update v2.0: Portals portals and more portals #3
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

We are always looking for new ways to make the game more challenging and immersive, with the latest beta release we have included several new features to the game. One of the ways we have decided to tackle this is by looking at how the enemies exist within side the game. We have created a new way for them to spawn in to the game by using a portal. These portals will appear near the player as a structure releasing new enemies into the world, giving a much more powerful entrance as the world around you begins to shake. Once all the enemies have [spawned] or [been killed] this portal will disappear into the abyss allowing the player to continue on down their path. There are now also a new variation of the portals that will spawn specific types of creatures into the world such as flying, fire, or shadow types.

Of course we have kept the old approach with their presence being already in the game to help add variance. This combined with the new approach we hope to create a much more immersive experience for the player on their conquest through the dungeons.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12082922/bc56e5b60e47df4a226204ef72203cbfe443d95b.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12082922/8919ce608a5939373b2a64ca98038973d7b1d59c.jpg[/img]

Please let us know your thoughts, we'd love to hear them!

Thank you,
Glow Games Studio

notes.title: Preview Update v2.0: New Lighting Mode #2
notes.content:
After much feedback with the very passionate community, we learnt that even on the hardest difficulties the game just isn't difficult enough. How about that? You guys are getting good! So to appeal to this, now when you play Insane or Legendary Dungeons and Robots has now drastically reduced the players vision. We approached this by turning off the ambient lighting, and producing a light that the robot emits and the direction that they are facing. This is to make it harder to spot where the enemy is and what direction they come from. There is also a 50% chance of this happening on hard mode. 

In the game, of course there are still areas in which lights will exist to enable the player to still see where their objective is. We believe that adding this approach will make the game more challenging for the player whilst they explore the hidden depths of the dungeon. We hope that this feature adds a more creative way to immerse the player as well as adding a subtle difficulty that will make even the most experienced players more alert to their surroundings. 

Once again please let us know your thoughts, we'd love to hear them!

Thank you,

We approached this by turning off the ambient lighting, and producing a light that the robot emits and the direction that they are facing. This is to make it harder to spot where the enemy is and what direction they come from. There is also a 50% chance of this happening on hard mode. 

In the game, of course there are still areas in which lights will exist to enable the player to still see where their objective is. We believe that adding this approach will make the game more challenging for the player whilst they explore the hidden depths of the dungeon. We hope that this feature adds a more creative way to immerse the player as well as adding a subtle difficulty that will make even the most experienced players more alert to their surroundings. 

Once again please let us know your thoughts, we'd love to hear them!

notes.title: The final stretch in our stage of production
notes.content:
[h1]Hi All![/h1]

We know that we have been away for some time, and we apologies for keeping you all in the dark. Due to the vast responses we have received we had to go away for some time and to think over our strategy, but one thing has stayed the same the same, our passion for Dungeons and Robots. In this period but we have been hard at work to make things better for Dungeons and Robots, this isn’t the end but the beginning of the final stretch in our stage of production for this project so it is time to unveil all of our hard work!  

Glow Games Studio would like to take this opportunity to thank everybody for their time and feedback, we massively appreciate anything suggested by the community as this is the thing that allows for any indie game to become successful. Everything that is said we have gone through and discussed how we can improvements in these areas and what approach is best to carry foreword. A lot suggestions you have given us has had incredible impact on the development of the game and although at times it may seem as if we might not been listening we can assure you that we have.

So, whats next? We are going to give weekly updates on the changes that we have been making. These will be small bitesized post's to make it easier to digest for the reader. Instead of previously what was more of a bug check off list. This approach is to help as we lead up to the Beta launch 2.0. Quick highlight over the changes we have made: the game is built to be more stable now, there should be less “lag” and FPS dropping. Rebuilt the AI system so now the enemies are more “intelligent”. A vast optimisation has taken place, areas of clipping have been removed, unnecessary memory has been reduced, so that a lot more machines can now play it smoothly.

We hope that you all continue to follow and support us and we will do our best to make sure to listen to everyone. Also feel free to follow the links down below, on twitter and indieDB as we like to post up our progress and screenshots of what we are working on. And if you want to get in contact, use any of these links and we will respond to you as soon as possible

[url=https://discord.gg/zqDzMwW]Discord Channel[/url]

Thank you again,

Glow Games Studio
